from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit
import hashlib, json, re

class Capture(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.hidden = 0
        self.parts = []
        self.links = set()
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        if tag in ('script', 'style', 'noscript'):
            self.hidden += 1
        if self.hidden or tag != 'a':
            return
        href = dict(attrs).get('href')
        if not href:
            return
        url = urlsplit(urljoin('https://www.zoho.com/affiliate/', href))
        if url.scheme == 'https' and url.hostname in ('zoho.com', 'www.zoho.com') and re.search(r'affiliate|terms|payout|commission', url.path, re.I):
            self.links.add(url._replace(query='', fragment='').geturl())
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag in ('script', 'style', 'noscript') and self.hidden:
            self.hidden -= 1
        if not self.hidden and tag in ('p', 'li', 'section', 'div', 'h2', 'h3', 'h4'):
            self.parts.append('\n')
    def handle_data(self, data):
        if not self.hidden:
            self.parts.append(data)

source = Path('products/distribution/invoice-referral-fit/raw/zoho.html')
raw = source.read_bytes()
digest = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
assert digest == '060113c16960955f5d235f4b2b145b702f9b407f4348afdbeb67155031472885'
page = Capture()
page.feed(raw.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
pattern = re.compile(r'commission|payout|threshold|cookie|paid customer|eligib|tax|disclos|canada|refund|affiliate agreement', re.I)
lines = [' '.join(line.split()) for line in ''.join(page.parts).splitlines()]
passages = list(dict.fromkeys(line for line in lines if pattern.search(line) and len(line) <= 1200))
result = {'source': 'https://www.zoho.com/affiliate/', 'capture_sha256': digest, 'scope': 'Navigation aid. Verify applicability and wording in the original capture.', 'passages': passages[:45], 'policy_link_candidates': sorted(page.links)[:25]}
out = Path('products/distribution/invoice-referral-fit/zoho-policy-pointers.json')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
assert json.loads(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) == result
print(json.dumps({'artifact': str(out), 'source_sha256': digest, 'passages': len(result['passages']), 'policy_links': len(result['policy_link_candidates'])}))
